title: Selling used sheets?
text: Selling used sheets?. I purchased sheets for my mom.  They arrived without a box and smelled like fabric softener.  They are not as pictured, they are a light blue back ground instead of white.  The (print) flowers look the same as pictured.  Don’t sell things as new when they used.  Let down, beware of buyer.  Nice sheets if they were new.
